description: Turn fake pixel art (an AI image or an upscaled screenshot where each "pixel" is a blurry block of slightly different colours) into real pixel art: finds the pixel grid, rebuilds it at 1 pixel per cell with one clean colour per cell, and can limit the colours or map them to a palette. Removes a fake checkerboard background first. Runs on this computer and saves the results as files.

cell.description: Size of one art pixel in the source, if you know it. Found automatically when left out.

out_dir.description: Folder for the results. Default: next to the input file.

outline.description: Add a 1 pixel dark outline around the sprite.

palette.description: Map to a palette: pico-8, sweetie-16, endesga-32, gameboy, nes-like, or hex codes like "#1a1c2c #b13e53 ...".

path.description: Full path of a PNG or JPG file on this computer. With a GameShipKit Pro key (GAMESHIPKIT_KEY) it can also be a folder, and every image in it is processed.

scale.description: Also save a copy scaled up this many times with sharp pixels.

name: fix_pixel_art
title: Fix fake pixel art
